caste.quote: We did not include soldiers of dimorphic genera such as Pheidole, as soldiers were relatively rare.

basisOfRecord.quote: Ant assemblages were collected at nine paired pasture and remnant sites from within three areas along a 300 km distance.
We commenced by measuring 20 morphological traits on a single specimen of 24 different genera (verified by HG).
Measured specimens were taken from all three areas and both habitat types when possible.

measurementStatistic.quote: We measured ten functional morphological traits for replicate individuals of each species.
We commenced by measuring 20 morphological traits on a single specimen of 24 different genera (verified by HG).
We used average trait values for all analyses, even for highly polymorphic genera (e.g., Camponotus and Melophorus).
